reason: I already have a boutique near Hillcroft I trust, and I'm at the halal markets every weekend anyway, so I don't need a new store. Westheimer means a separate drive, and 15% off isn't enough to make me switch from someone who already knows my size and taste.
objection: I don't know these people. My shop gets me, and I'd only be going to a new place to try it, not because I need anything right now.
would_change_my_mind: If friends or family I trust wore their pieces to a wedding or henna night and the embroidery and fabric really stood out, I'd go and look before Eid.
